doc.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Parents' reluctance about touring with Snookum Russell
summary: His father opposed his leaving home but his mother persuaded him to come around.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I understand there was some consternation on the part of your parents when you wanted to go with Snookum Russell because of the traveling and what have you.
They were concerned about you being away.
My dad was the most concerned and the most reluctant to have me indulge in

this enterprise. My mother took the stance that, well, we may as well support him in this because he’s going to do it anyway. Since we can’t stop him, we may as well go along with the program and endorse it. Finally my dad came around and said, "Well, yeah. You’re right."
